ORDINANCE XXI OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2001
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS AMENDMENT
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part 1,
26th June, 20011
NO.S.LEGIS.1(21)/2001, dated 26‑6‑2001.‑‑‑
The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh Js hereby published for
general information:‑‑‑
2. Amendment of section 5 of
Sindh Act XIV of 1973.‑‑--In the Sindh Civil Servants Act,
1973, in section 5, in the proviso, for the words "one percentum of such
appointments", the words "two percentum of such appointments in posts
in basic pay scale 15 and below" shall be substituted.
